Hypervelocity.title: Hypervelocity
Hypervelocity.description: You have obtained the power to run and incredible speeds

first_tick_commands: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with eop:dna_capsule{speedster:"eop_true",display:{Name:'["",{"text":"Hypervelocity","color":"blue","italic":false},{"text":" DNA Capsule","italic":false}]'}}

enabling.command: execute anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^2.1 if entity @e[type=arrow,distance=..3]
execute anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^2.1 if entity @e[type=arrow,distance=..3]

commands: execute anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^2.1 as @e[type=arrow,distance=..3] run data modify entity @s inGround set value 1b
execute anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^2.1 as @e[type=arrow,distance=..3] run data modify entity @s pickup set value 1b
execute anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^2.1 at @e[type=arrow,distance=..3] run tp @e[type=arrow,distance=..0.1] @s

Secondary.Ability.title: Dodge
Secondary.Ability.description: Dodge most attacks just before being hit. §dBattlemode §fmust be enabled via keybind. §dRight Click §fto use this ability

first_tick_commands: execute if score @s EOP.Dodge.Animation matches 1 run tag @s add Dodge.Anim1
execute if score @s EOP.Dodge.Animation matches 2 run tag @s add Dodge.Anim2
execute if score @s EOP.Dodge.Animation matches 2.. run scoreboard players set @s EOP.Dodge.Animation 0

Activate.Speed.Unlock.title: Hyperspeed
Activate.Speed.Unlock.description: Activate your incredible speed. §dScroll up or down §fwhile holding this ability to change your speed

Activate.Speed.title: Hyperspeed
last_tick_commands: execute if score @s Speed.Velocity matches 1.. run scoreboard players set @s Speed.Velocity 0

commands: execute if score @s Speed.Velocity matches 100.. run scoreboard players set @s[predicate=!eop:is_sneaking] Speed.Velocity 100
execute if score @s Speed.Velocity matches ..0 run scoreboard players set @s Speed.Velocity 0

Step.Assist2.title: Hyperspeed
last_tick_commands: execute unless predicate eop:is_sprinting run scale reset pehkui:step_height @s

Waypoint.Unlock.title: Fast Travel
Waypoint.Unlock.description: With incredible speed, fast travel back to a location of your choosing. §dSneak §fto set or remove waypoint

Waypoint.title: Fast Travel
first_tick_commands: execute if predicate eop:is_sneaking run playsound minecraft:block.note_block.bell master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1
execute if predicate eop:is_sneaking run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Location marked!","color":"green","bold":true}]
execute if predicate eop:is_sneaking run tag @s add EOP.Waypoint.Saved

Waypoint.Switch.Begin.title: Fast Travel
first_tick_commands: execute unless predicate eop:is_sneaking run playsound minecraft:entity.evoker.prepare_attack master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2
execute unless predicate eop:is_sneaking run tag @s add Speedster.Begin.Fast.Travel
execute if predicate eop:is_sneaking run title @s actionbar ["",{"text":"Location removed!","color":"red","bold":true}]
execute if predicate eop:is_sneaking run playsound minecraft:block.note_block.snare master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 1
execute if predicate eop:is_sneaking run tag @s remove EOP.Waypoint.Saved

Lightning.Unlock.title: Living Lightning
Lightning.Unlock.description: Focus your power and become one with lightning
